en.headline: 2027 DSE registration opens Friday; GBA centres extended three years
en.dek: The HKEAA will take entries from 11 September to 7 October and is studying an increase in mainland participating schools from four to 12.
body: The Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority said registration for the 2027 Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education Examination will run from Friday, 11 September, to 7 October 2026 for Category A, B and C subjects.

School candidates must be Secondary 6 students at registered schools approved to enter the 2027 exam, with schools handling entries. Private candidates may apply online if they have sat the DSE before or will be 19 by 1 January 2027. Others must file a special-entry application. Each candidate may enter a maximum of eight subjects.

The authority said Hong Kong and mainland education authorities had agreed to extend the Greater Bay Area mainland examination-centre pilot for another three years, from 2027 to 2029, after about 800 eligible Hong Kong and Macau school candidates sat papers there in the first three years. It is studying a gradual increase in mainland participating schools from four to 12 and said the arrangement would not add competition for publicly funded local university places.

zh.headline: 2027文憑試周五起報名 內地試場續試行三年
zh.dek: 考評局公布9月11日至10月7日接受報名，並探討將大灣區內地與考學校由4所增至12所。
body: 香港考試及評核局公布，2027年香港中學文憑考試甲、乙及丙類科目將於9月11日（星期五）至10月7日接受報名。
學校考生須為獲准參加2027年文憑試的註冊學校中六正讀生，由學校統一報名。自修生如曾應考文憑試，或於2027年1月1日已年滿19歲，可經網上服務自行報名；未符資格者須提交特殊報考申請。每名考生最多可報考八科。
考評局表示，香港與內地教育部門同意將大灣區內地考場「先行先試」安排再延長三年至2029年。首三年已安排約800名合資格港澳籍學校考生在內地應考。當局正探討以循序漸進方式，將內地與考學校由現時4所增至12所，並指安排不會增加本地學生入讀資助大學的學額競爭。
